# Think Web Pros

> Think Web Pros lets small businesses design and customize their own SEO and GEO optimized website at a low cost, then launch it with hosting and web services.

- Design is free in the Think Web Pros Studio (https://thinkwebpros.com/builder). Owners click any text or photo to change it, on a phone, tablet or computer.
- Logos: upload your own, or use the AI logo maker (first 3 requests free, AI logo package $49 once). A designer-drawn logo is $149.
- 8 structurally different styles (Classic, Magazine, Loud, Luxe, Playful, Glass, Portfolio, Retro), each with light and dark versions.
- SEO and GEO: sites state the business name, address, phone and services clearly so search engines and AI assistants can understand and recommend them.

## Pricing (USD)

- Starter: $299 one-time design + $19/month. Up to 6 sections, free thinkwebpros.com address, hosting and SSL, basic owner dashboard, email support.
- Growth: $599 one-time design + $39/month. Up to 10 sections, own domain and email, full owner dashboard, 1 hour of edits per month, phone and email support.
- Pro: $1,199 one-time design + $79/month. Up to 20 sections, SEO boost and live chat included, no Think Web Pros badge, 3 hours of edits per month, priority support.
- Add-ons: online booking $15/mo, online store $29/mo, custom domain and email $8/mo, SEO boost $49/mo, live chat $12/mo, remove badge $5/mo, copywriting $199 once, photo shoot $249 once, point of sale from $39/mo.
